newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Cephalon trades near day's close.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Cephalon trades near day's close.

text.p: Cephalon Inc was trading at 12-7/8 in the after-hours session, near the day's close of 13 on the Nasdaq Stock Market, apparently still moving on news that one of its drugs had been rejected.

Cephalon fell 7 to close at 13, while Chiron Corp edged 7/8 lower to 19-1/8 during normal trading hours after the Food and Drug Administration rejected their Myotrophin drug for the Lou Gehrig's Disease.
Intel Corp's stock was trading lightly at 159-7/8 against a close of 159-1/2 after announcing that its new Pentium II chip had a flaw but no recall was necessary.
American Greetings Corp was staying along its close of 31-9/16. The price was lower than the previous day's 33 following news that a court had dismissed an action filed by the company.
The action sought to declare that it had not breached a confidentiality agreement with BEC Group Inc in offering to buy of one of the group's businesses.
Its stock ended 1-7/16 lower during normal hours.
The New York Stock Exchange said Friday that session one had a volume of 70,400 shares compared to 16,400 the day before, while session two had 965,300 against 20.1 million.
